name: DexH13 Gen 2
summary: DexH13 is PaXini's second-generation four-finger hand combining multidimensional tactile sensing with palm-mounted vision. Its 16 degrees of freedom comprise 13 active and three passive axes. The manufacturer lists 1,140 tactile sensing units and an 8 MP RGB camera for contact and object-position information. Coreless motors drive the fingers, with EtherCAT and Modbus interfaces for integration. The official page gives a 5 kg rated load and identifies industrial, logistics and service applications; stated performance and durability figures originate from PaXini's laboratory testing.
